definitions.equal_weight_mean: arithmetic mean of positive valid per-security multiples
definitions.ratio_of_totals: sum(market_value)/sum(denominator) over the identical positive valid set; not a market-cap-weighted mean
definitions.rank_ic: Spearman(-multiple, next-session-close to next-formation-next-session-close adjusted-price return), conditional on resolved endpoints; >=25 signals, >=10 outcomes
definitions.quintiles: rank ascending multiple; average-rank ties kept together; equal initial weights, fixed shares within the month; incomplete basket unavailable
definitions.cost: additive 0/10/30 bp per traded notional; L1 target minus previous drifted weights; cash only initially, no reset after missing marks; terminal liquidation included; no fill/cash-ledger certification
definitions.status: known prior-announced active name plus listing interval and matching reconstructed positive state; *ST before ST; absence alone never establishes non-ST
definitions.all_market: all quoted positive-market-value rows, including unknown status; return diagnostics additionally require a listing interval; not independently complete exchange membership
